teaser.en: A sprawling seashore shrub whose glossy leaves lather like soap when rubbed in water.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha ufuoni kinachotambaa, ambacho majani yake yanayong'aa hutoa povu kama sabuni yakisuguliwa ndani ya maji.

summary.en: Msuko is Colubrina asiatica, a scrambling shrub of beach thickets and the edges of mangroves. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Msuko ni Colubrina asiatica, kichaka kinachotambaa katika vichaka vya ufuoni na pembezoni mwa mikoko. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.

about.en: Msuko is a sprawling or climbing shrub with long, flexible, zig-zag branches. Its leaves are alternate, egg-shaped, shiny bright green and finely toothed, with three main veins. The tiny greenish-yellow flowers are clustered in the leaf angles and are followed by small round capsules that split into three when dry.
about.sw: Msuko ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, chenye matawi marefu, yanayopindika na kwenda kombo kombo. Majani yake yanapishana, yana umbo la yai, ni ya kijani angavu yanayong'aa na yana meno madogo, na mishipa mitatu mikuu. Maua madogo sana ya kijani-manjano yamesongamana kwenye pembe za majani na hufuatwa na vifuko vidogo vya mviringo vinavyopasuka sehemu tatu vikikauka.

where.en: It grows just behind the beach, in coastal thicket, on coral rock and on the landward edges of mangroves. Its seeds float, which is how it has spread along tropical coasts from Africa to the Pacific.
where.sw: Huota nyuma kidogo ya ufuo, katika vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani, kwenye miamba ya matumbawe na pembezoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu. Mbegu zake huelea, na kwa njia hiyo umeenea kando ya pwani za kitropiki kutoka Afrika hadi Pasifiki.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere around the Indian Ocean and Pacific the leaves, which are rich in saponins, are well known for lathering in water and are used as a soap substitute.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi na Pasifiki, majani yake, yenye saponini nyingi, yanajulikana sana kwa kutoa povu ndani ya maji na hutumika badala ya sabuni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Msuko but gives no meaning or shared names. The same name is used for Grewia holstii (also called Msokoto). In English it is Asian nakedwood or latherleaf; its scientific name is Colubrina asiatica.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Msuko lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa Grewia holstii (inayoitwa pia Msokoto). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Asian nakedwood* au *latherleaf*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Colubrina asiatica.

reason.en: Another shrub of the beach thicket
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha vichaka vya ufuoni

reason.en: Also grows at the mangrove's landward edge
reason.sw: Nao pia huota pembezoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu
